## Summary

Describe the change and why it matters.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Manifesto or lifecycle content
- [ ] Shared skills or documentation
- [ ] Website or metadata
- [ ] Translation
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Checks

- [ ] I have reviewed the changed pages or documents.
- [ ] I updated related translations or noted why not.
- [ ] I updated the changelog when relevant.
- [ ] I ran `make check` when relevant.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, `.env`, or local system files.
